card.name: Verbs after 'agents that' in interactions
card.fires_on: Verbs or adjectives like alter, block, lower and effective right after 'agents/drugs that' or before a dose or effect noun in drug interaction text. It also fires inside a few odd split words such as Gesund-brunnen.

modes.label: Verb after 'agents that'
modes.description: An action verb follows 'agents that' or 'drugs that' in an interaction statement.
modes.example: Hydrochlorothiazide Drugs that<< Alter>> Gastrointestinal Motility

modes.label: 'Effective' before a noun
modes.description: The word effective sits before dose, period or suppression terms.
modes.example: use the lowest<< effective>> dose for the shortest duration possible.

modes.label: Inside split proper words
modes.description: Partway through a rare word that is split into pieces, outside of drug text.

card.plain: It marks the verb or adjective that says what a drug does or how it is described, such as agents that alter or lower something.
